answers.struck: Dust puffs from the joints. Under the iron it is stone.
answers.touched: Your hand comes away grey. Nobody has dusted this one in a while.

answers.struck: The mail rings once and goes still. It does not feel the blow.
answers.touched: Cold, as if it had stood in the snow all night. It has not moved in a century.

answers.struck: A statue of the old watch. Hit it all you like; the captain is the one to leave alone.
answers.touched: Carved on the plinth: hold the post. It has.

answers.struck: Stone. It has been hit by better swords than yours.
answers.touched: Somebody has tucked a note into its gauntlet: do not feed the sentries.

answers.struck: Iron over stone, and the iron is warm. The captain does not stir yet.
answers.touched: The sword hand is closed tight round the hilt. It is not carved that way.

answers.struck: A hollow clang. The iron golem was the hall's guard once; now it is part of the hall.
answers.touched: Moss in the seams of its arms. It has stood here longer than the keeper.
